{{Top|leg}}
'''Cred sticks''' were a form of electronic currency that gained popularity after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A pen-sized device, cred sticks functioned almost exactly like a [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]] but took up less space.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
